title: Pas Normal Studios Introduces T.K.O. AW26: Everything In Its Right Place
content:
As the days grow shorter and temperatures fall, the memory of summer takes on a different significance. The warmth of the sun, the colours of the landscape and the feeling of riding on those sunlit days become something to hold onto. For Autumn/Winter 2026, Pas Normal Studios translates these impressions into its latest T.K.O. collection.

T.K.O. is the brand’s signature outlet for artistic expression, offering a more experimental approach to cycling apparel under the creative direction of co-founder Karl-Oskar Olsen. For AW26, a dark red backdrop sets the tone, with graphics recalling the warmth of summer and bringing a sense of nostalgia into the colder riding season.

The collection brings this creative vision to both lightweight and cold-weather cycling apparel, built around the Essential Light and newly introduced Mechanism Thermal programmes. A selection of accessories completes the release, carrying the same visual identity throughout.

Product Highlights

T.K.O. Mechanism Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey 2.0

Designed for high-intensity riding in cold and wet conditions, the jersey combines Polartec® Power Shield Pro Knit for wind and water resistance with Polartec® Power Grid for enhanced breathability and moisture management. Its hybrid construction delivers weather protection and aerodynamic performance, with a 20,000mm water column rating and 20,000 g/m²/24h breathability.

T.K.O. Mechanism Thermal Long Bibs

Crafted in Italy from high-stretch, fleeced fabric, the bibs provide insulation and freedom of movement for cold-weather riding. A C0 DWR treatment offers protection against light rain and road spray, while ergonomically shaped legs, fleeced shoulder straps and silicone grid grippers ensure a secure, comfortable fit over long distances.

T.K.O. Essential Light Jersey

Defined by a balance of structure and expression, the T.K.O. Essential Light Jersey brings a distinct graphic approach to everyday riding. Lightweight materials support breathability and comfort across changing conditions. Cut in an updated Essential fit with a slightly closer silhouette, the jersey is designed for layering and extended use.

T.K.O. Essential Light Cargo Bibs

The T.K.O. Essential Light Cargo Bibs are a lightweight summer bib built for long days in warm conditions. Constructed in a breathable stretch-woven fabric with the signature Essential Light structure, they balance durability and comfort. Laser-cut hems and the signature strap material ensure a secure fit, while a cargo pocket on the right leg provides practical storage without
disrupting the clean silhouette.

Availability

The T.K.O. AW26 collection will be available from 27 November at Pas Normal Studios stores, selected retailers and online.
